
## --- EXAMPLE COMMIT BASED ON TEMPLATE BELOW (write your commit without # above) ---
# feat(tokens): add marble light and dark surface tokens
# ONE BLANK LINE BETWEEN FIELDS
# The marble theme needs surface and vein colors that hold contrast in
# both color schemes. Tokens live on :root and are redefined under the
# dark-mode selectors so components never hard-code a color.
# ONE BLANK LINE BETWEEN FIELDS
# Refs: DES-002

## --- BARE TEMPLATE ---
# <type>(<scope>): <subject>  --> 50 chars max, imperative mood, no period at the end

# <body - optional: WHY this change? (wrap at 72 chars)>

# <footer - optional: ISSUE_LOG IDs, breaking changes, co-authors>

## DESCRIPTION OF RULES FOR EACH FIELD
# --- TYPES ---
# feat:     new feature, page, section, or capability
# fix:      bug fix (broken layout, link, asset, build error)
# docs:     documentation only (README, .github/ conventions)
# refactor: change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
# perf:     performance improvement (asset size, load time)
# test:     adding or fixing tests or checks
# chore:    tooling / dependencies / config, housekeeping
# build:    changes to the build system (Gemfile, _config.yml build settings)
# ci:       CI / CD pipeline changes (GitHub Actions, Pages deploy)
# style:    whitespace / formatting only, no change in behavior or rendering

# --- SCOPES: part of the site being touched ---
# layout    _layouts/ and _includes/ structure
# tokens    design tokens: colors, type scale, spacing, themes
# content   copy and prose on pages
# assets    images, video, PDFs under assets/
# data      _data/ YAML files
# story     story / about section
# work      work / projects section and case-study pages
# home      home page
# perf      performance work spanning several areas
# a11y      accessibility
# seo       metadata, sitemap, social cards
# repo      repo meta: .gitignore, .github/, conventions

# --- SUBJECT ---
# 1 - Imperative mood: "add X", not "added X" or "adds X". It completes
#     the sentence "If applied, this commit will ___."
# 2 - Lowercase the first letter (after the type/scope).
# 3 - No period at the end.
# 4 - <= 50 characters if possible. Hard ceiling 72.
# 5 - Tells what changed, not why; the why goes in the body.

# --- BODY ---
# 1 - Separated from the subject by a blank line.
# 2 - Wrap at 72 characters.
# 3 - Explains the why: motivation, context, alternatives tried, why this approach won.
# 4 - Bullets are fine when listing several reasons.

# --- FOOTER ---
# 1 - Separated from the body by a blank line. One trailer per line.
# 2 - ISSUE_LOG reference: "Closes: <ID>" if the commit finishes the issue,
#     "Refs: <ID>" if it advances it. ID = <CAT>-<nnn>,
#     CAT in DES, FUN, UX, UI, PERF, CON, REPO (e.g. Closes: FUN-002).
# 3 - Breaking change: "BREAKING CHANGE: <what breaks and how to migrate>".
# 4 - No Co-Authored-By or other attribution trailers.
